judgment_text:
The Judgment of the Court was delivered by

N. Sathish Kumar, J.:— The instant writ appeals have been filed challenging the order of the learned Single Judge directing the Court appointed Administrator, Hon'ble Dr Justice P. Jyothimani to resume his charge and continue the election process and take it to its logical conclusion.

2. The issue is with regard to the election process for the Thoothukudi Nazareth Diocese. There were several litigations with regard to this issue.

3. In O.S.A. No. 10 of 2026 filed with regard to the same issue, the principal Bench of this Court has elaborately discussed the issue and concluded the original side appeal. Later the said order was also challenged before the Supreme Court in S.L.P. Nos. 5272 & 5282 of 2026 and the said Special Leave Petitions were also dismissed. Now it appears that the entire election process has already been over and the Synod has also approved the election process conducted by Hon'ble Dr Justice P. Jyothimani.

4. Now, suits have also been filed in C.S. Nos. 311 of 2026 and 4 of 2026 and are pending before the Madras High Court, challenging certain actions.

5. In such view of the matter, as the prime issue relating to the election process is already over, we are of the definite opinion that nothing survives in these writ appeals. Since the civil suits are pending, let the parties shall agitate their rights in the pending suit based on the evidence and pleadings.

6. Accordingly, the writ appeals are dismissed as infructuous. Consequently, connected miscellaneous petitions are closed. There shall be no order as to costs.
